notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Dragons and/or Illusions.
description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
